summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) attaching a news release announcing its presentation at the 2026 BIO International Convention. The company will showcase its proprietary Botanical Synthesis platform for plant-derived compounds. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on ordinary business activities, presenting at an industry conference and promoting business development.
